steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.body: In main mixing bowl, cream together: **1 cup salted butter**, barely softened, **1 cup white (granulated) sugar** and **1 cup light brown sugar**, packed.

steps.title: Beat in
steps.body: Then beat in: **2 tsp vanilla extract** and **2 large eggs**.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: In a separate bowl, mix: **3 cups all-purpose flour**, **1 tsp baking soda**, **½ tsp baking powder** and **1 tsp sea salt**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Mix in dry ingredients and add **12 oz (2 cups) chocolate chips**.

steps.title: Shape
steps.body: Mix well and roll into balls of 2-3 Tbsp.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 8-10 minutes, pulling them out when they are barely starting to brown.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Let sit on the baking pan for 2 minutes before removing to a cooling rack.
